## 0x3C8C terrain_vertex_cache_valid

R is pointer from G+0x94. In mode 1, nonzero skips terrain vertex rebuild; 0x4C47F2 sets 1, camera setter 0x4C3C5A clears 0. Live invalidation not yet verified.
